parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the storage furniture, made of plywood panels forming the outer shell and internal supports.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and houses the drawers, ensuring stability and alignment for smooth drawer operation.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports the entire cabinet structure.

parts.name: Top Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The top drawer is a small pull-out compartment made of MDF, located at the upper section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It is used for storing small items that need to be accessed frequently, such as stationery or utensils.
parts.Movement_description: It slides horizontally in and out along metal or wooden rails.

parts.name: Middle Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The middle drawer is a medium-sized pull-out compartment made of MDF, positioned between the top and bottom drawers.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage for medium-sized items, balancing accessibility and capacity.
parts.Movement_description: It slides horizontally in and out along rails similar to the other drawers.

parts.name: Bottom Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The bottom drawer is the largest pull-out compartment made of MDF, located at the base of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It is used for storing larger or heavier items that are less frequently accessed.
parts.Movement_description: It slides horizontally in and out along rails, similar to the other drawers.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom support structure of the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and weight distribution for the entire cabinet, preventing tipping or wobbling.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports the cabinet on the floor.
